basic_info.description: Beautiful and situated in a prime Richmond location. Top level vacant features 2 bedrooms and 1.5 bath room with art deco trims and crown mouldings and a bright skylight. The kitchen and bath was updated within 6-10 year. Freshly painted throughout and refinished flooring. Close to school and grocery shopping. It comes with a bonus room and expansion opportunities in the back of the garage. 2 of the 3 units are tenants occupied.
